description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring an early-career Software Engineer for its Space business. The role designs, develops, tests, and maintains software on an Agile development team supporting business and mission needs.
Software developer building, testing, debugging, and documenting business and mission applications

Responsibilities:
• In this role, you will be designing, developing, and testing Software on an Agile Development Team
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• In this role, you will be designing, developing, and testing Software on an Agile Development Team
• The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of C#, Angular, C++, DevOps, and Kubernetes
• Must be a US Citizen; this position and requires a final secret clearance to start
• Bachelor's degree in disciplines such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Systems Engineering, Physics, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Cyber Security or related discipline
• Agile Software Development
• Must be a US Citizen; this position will require obtaining a government security clearance
• Ability to obtain a DOD-Secret Clearance required for this role

Preferred:
• Proficiency in one of the related: C#, Java, Angular, C++, web development, software automated test, system and software design
• Strong Problem Solver
• Works both independently and in team settings
